title: A memo whose only citation could not be retrieved, said so, and carries no figure that depends on it; the result recomputes from the supplied scores (clean control for evidence limits)

proof.python:
import csv
r = list(csv.DictReader(open('scores.csv')))
b = sum(int(x['before']) for x in r) / 10; a = sum(int(x['after']) for x in r) / 10
assert len(r) == 10 and round(b, 1) == 56.6 and round(a, 1) == 60.7 and round(a - b, 1) == 4.1
assert sum(1 for x in r if int(x['after']) > int(x['before'])) == 9 and sum(1 for x in r if int(x['after']) == int(x['before'])) == 1
m = open('note.md').read()
assert 'Okafor' in m and 'could not retrieve' in m
